### A Prayer for Clarity about Your God-Given Purpose
Author: Heather Caliri
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-clarity-about-your-god-given-purpose-your-daily-prayer-august-24-2017.html
Passage: Psalm 138:8
Points:
- Finding God's purpose is an ongoing discipleship journey rather than a single static milestone.
- Divine purpose is often discovered within ordinary, unglamorous daily responsibilities.
- Walking in God's calling produces deep spiritual joy even in difficult seasons.
- Fulfilling your life's purpose depends on God's enabling power and faithful guidance.

### Hidden Hardships Behind Closed Doors
Author: Sharon Glasgow
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/hidden-hardships-behind-closed-doors-encouragement-for-today-august-28-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 138:3
Points:
- Severe personal and family hardships are often hidden from outward appearances.
- Crying out to God in prayer infuses the soul with supernatural strength and courage.
- Maintaining disciplined daily communion with God sustains believers through intense trials.
- Faithfulness in prayer leaves a profound spiritual legacy for future generations.
